# Independent audit of the all-template shape-aware shell obstruction

Source read in full: `candidate 2d5ed8c78661db43`.

**Result: PASS, no repair needed.** Independent verifier `supporting computation verify_all_template_shell_obstruction_slab_recovery.py` passes **25 exact rational checks**, including the printed binomial sum and the original-mass gap. The arbitrary-template and all-halfspace steps are proved geometrically below, not inferred from the finite checker.

## 1. Exact shape constants and certificate scope

The complementary through-centroid cap fractions sum to one, giving beta(J)<=1/2. Taking a threshold beyond both support extrema gives one full and one empty tail, so kappa(J)<=1/2. These facts require no symmetry of J. The shape-aware certificate follows from the previously audited disjoint shell proof: pairs pay 2kappa, captured shells and the own core pay beta, and the generic closed-atomic identity is D=w_p+R+D(residual). Replacing only the own-core term by exact original own-fiber depth is valid and does not reuse any other fiber measure. Pure integer caps satisfy the same bound because full-copy mass dominates 2kappa and full-shell mass dominates beta.

The obstruction permits arbitrary centroided J, arbitrary affine placement map, arbitrary nonnegative contained radii, every actual anchor, and the exact own depth. It does not purport to bound certificates that use additional geometric information about original fibers outside these copies.

## 2. Uniform template bound and exact constants

For r=min(r_-,r_+), each coordinate width of rJ is bounded by the corresponding side length of both endpoint boxes, regardless of the translations of the two copies. The enclosing coordinate bounding box therefore has volume at most the product of the smaller side lengths. This gives V min(w_-,w_+)<=a^(-100) uniformly over every convex template, including unaligned and nonsymmetric ones. Zero radii give the same inequality directly.

The endpoint volumes are one, and the exact midpoint volume is (1681/1680)^100. The geometric-series comparison gives k<84/79<16/15. The displayed finite binomial sum equals 4209933/40000>100 exactly, proving t<1/100. The exponential-series comparison and factorial-tail bound give Gamma_200>4/11. The signs and all strict comparisons survive the exact rational checks.

## 3. Actual asymmetric body and all-point depth upper bound

The added point is beyond exactly the positive first-coordinate box facet and strictly inside all other facet halfspaces. The added region is precisely the pyramid on that facet, up to null boundary, with volume Fh/d=epsilon. Its positive first-coordinate moment makes the middle centroid nonzero; reflection in every other coordinate makes the remaining centroid coordinates zero. The endpoint centroids remain zero, so the three-fiber graph is nonaffine.

The lifted convex hull has precisely the three stated integer fibers. At integer base zero, any interpolation of the two endpoints lies in their exact Minkowski midpoint K_0, which is already contained in K. Thus no untracked fiber enlargement occurs. Every fiber is full d-dimensional and the intrinsic measure is the stated d-volume sum.

For any continuous point y, the two complementary closed halfspaces through y in any nonzero direction split K_0 into masses summing to k, since the boundary has zero volume. One has mass at most k/2, and its intersection with the added pyramid is at most epsilon. Hence delta_K(y)<=k/2+epsilon for every candidate, even outside K_0. The endpoint own-depth upper bound 1/2 is equally uniform.

## 4. All anchors, optimized menu, and gap

At the middle base, D=w_0+min(w_-,w_+) and R=min(w_-,w_+), so the strengthened menu simplifies exactly to delta_K+2kappa V min(w_-,w_+). The uniform bounds give at most k/2+epsilon+t<1633/3000. At an endpoint, a base cap isolates that endpoint, so D=w_p and R=0 and the certificate is at most 1/2. This includes absent copies and every allowed affine center map.

The original mass remains M=2+k+epsilon. Its target exceeds 6/11, and 6/11-1633/3000=37/33000. Since the upper bound is uniform in all menu choices, the strict gap applies to their supremum as well; this is not merely a pointwise strictness argument.

For binary padding, any reflected pair at a binary anchor remains in that block. An exposing base functional with sufficiently large coefficient excludes every other block while preserving either required within-block chain sign pattern. Thus the atomic depth is at most its within-block value, and the same menu upper bound holds. The original mass factor and OC denominator cancel exactly. No new containment requirement or restriction on affine placement is introduced by this argument.

## 5. Independent actual good point

At Y=(0,0), the centrally symmetric contained middle box supplies k/2 in every nonvertical through-point cap. The two centered endpoint boxes face opposite threshold shifts, so at least one supplies 1/2. Therefore every such cap captures at least (k+1)/2. A pure integer cap contains the whole middle fiber and at least one endpoint, and a containing cap can be moved through Y. The comparison with the OC target follows from Gamma_d<=1/2 and k>epsilon, with strict surplus at least (k-epsilon)/4 over the corresponding half-constant upper target.

This proof uses no global symmetry of the full source. It establishes an actual deterministic OC point separately from the failing single-template menu. The padded examples retain this point in any chosen binary block, with other blocks contributing nonnegative mass.
